title: Gene regulatory network analysis identifies auranofin as an anti-atherosclerotic drug.
snippet: Gene-regulatory networks (GRNs) offer a mechanistic framework for dissecting the complex molecular and genetic architecture of coronary artery disease and for identifying new therapeutic opportunities.
